install.title: Install SwimQuest
install.subtitle: Add the app to your home screen for one-tap access.
install.zalo: You opened SwimQuest inside Zalo. Tap the ... menu and choose Open in browser first, then follow the steps for your phone.
install.ios1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
install.ios2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
install.ios3: Tap Add in the top right corner.
install.other2: Tap Install app or Add to Home screen.
install.other3: Confirm to place SwimQuest on your home screen.

update.title: A new version is available
update.body: Update to get the latest SwimQuest. Your swims and progress are kept.
